no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Halozyme is a drug-delivery technology company (ENHANZE rHuPH20, Hypercon, VIBEX/QuickShot auto-injectors). It does not run its own internal clinical-stage proprietary therapeutic candidates as the lead sponsor. Halozyme's two proprietary marketed products (Hylenex recombinant, XYOSTED) are commercial. The previously developed proprietary candidate ATRS-1902 (drug-device hydrocortisone) was discontinued in December 2025. All other clinical activity (DARZALEX FASPRO, Phesgo, TECENTRIQ HYBREZA, OCREVUS ZUNOVO, VYVGART Hytrulo, Opdivo Qvantig, RYBREVANT FASPRO, HYQVIA TAK-881, selatogrel auto-injector, ARGX-117/ARGX-213/ARGX-121, ViiV VH4524184, Acumen sabirnetug SC, Merus petosemtamab SC, Skye nimacimab SC) is partner-led and royalty/milestone-only — excluded per the partner-owned rule.
